name: Inference Atlas
description: Browse community inference measurements and benchmark local model servers with configuration fingerprints, coverage maps, and install recipes.
compatibility: The atlas-bench harness measures OpenAI-compatible inference servers, including tool-call evaluation workloads.
Documented adapters include vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama, MLX-LM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, LM Studio, and attach-only ExLlamaV3.
limitations: Early-stage project; coverage depends on contributed measurements, not universal engine, model, or hardware compatibility.
Benchmarking requires Python 3.11 or newer, a configured inference server, suitable model hardware, and a resolvable GitHub login for provenance.
The terminal UI requires Node.js 20 or newer, git, and pnpm; it browses data and generates recipes rather than serving models.
The terminal UI syncs published data on launch and periodically by default; cached data works offline, or --repo reads a local checkout with compiled data.
Benchmark telemetry samples local hardware by default and can be disabled; submitted results include contributor provenance and become public.
Code-execution grading runs generated code in a subprocess, not a security sandbox; avoid untrusted models on sensitive machines.
Code is MIT licensed; registry and measurement data use CC-BY-4.0, while third-party datasets and model weights retain their own terms.
